_comment: Player-facing vocabulary. World bible sections 1, 9 and 10. Change a word here and it changes everywhere.

facilityBlurbs.mine: Sinks a shaft on a vein of gold. Nothing else in the Seven Seas earns like it, and few islands have the ground for one.
facilityBlurbs.refinery: Cuts and works the standing timber. Wants a forest under it, and most islands have a few.
facilityBlurbs.construction_yard: Builds everything else on this island. Every yard here works the same job together.
facilityBlurbs.training_facility: Drills companies of marines and militia.
facilityBlurbs.shipyard: Lays down hulls. Nothing to build here until the fleets arrive.
facilityBlurbs.fort: A battery on the harbor wall. Fires on any enemy hull lying off the island, whether or not you have a fleet there, and no landing can be made while one still stands.
facilityBlurbs.heavy_fort: The same wall built twice over: more than twice the guns and two and a half times the stone, on the one plot a Fortress would have taken. Costs more per gun than two Fortresses would, and is the only answer on an island with no room left.
